product_one_liner.value: koppla provides real-time, collaborative construction scheduling and project coordination for general contractors, planners, property developers and architects.

pricing_page.notes: The public page describes its pricing model and project licensing, with pricing tailored to customer needs.

named_customers.notes: The announcement explicitly identifies these companies as customers.

eng_blog.notes: The index contains construction advice and product articles, not two qualifying engineer-authored posts about building the product.

public_docs.notes: The public help center has multiple article collections covering onboarding, planning, project control, analysis, exports and standardization.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The board lists Founders Associate—GTM/RevOps/Growth and Senior Product Engineer—Coding & People Leadership; neither is a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title.

model_provider.notes: No specific AI model or provider was disclosed in the reviewed product documentation, AI/security information, blog or Trust Center subprocessor list.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center lists ISO/IEC 27001 and GDPR under Compliance; GDPR is a compliance claim rather than a certification.

last_funding.notes: Announced on May 19, 2025 as a €6 million round. CB Insights labels it Seed VC–III and reports $6.76 million; stage labels differ across funding directories.

raised_18mo.notes: The €6 million funding announcement dated May 19, 2025 falls within the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A Sales Development Representative posting and application form remain accessible, although the role is absent from the main job index, creating some uncertainty about active recruitment.

launched_6mo.notes: On May 27, 2026, koppla introduced a BIM integration using automatically generated match keys to link schedules with 4D-BIM models.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small public team roster showed no qualifying recent appointment, and no in-window departure announcement was found. A documented managing-director departure was recorded in March 2025, outside the window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The SDR posting explicitly names these tools for managing the lead process.
